outcome_summary: Added mandatory two-tier authorization enforcement to the Application Framework API pipeline: a private authorize() gate in BaseAPIMethod checks method-access whitelists and pseudo-user rights for all APIKeyMethodInterface methods, backed by two new error constants (183005, 183006) and an HTTP 403 builder. All 20 HCP Editor write-operation API methods were updated with getRequiredRight() overrides using #[Override], covered by a new 20-case data-provider test suite. One QA rework cycle was required to fix a pre-existing test that assumed API keys required no explicit method grants; the fix is documented as a pattern change in testing.md. PHPStan is clean across all 5 work packages; no Critical or High security issues were found. One medium security follow-up remains: SetMailingStateAPI is missing a Tier 2 RIGHT_FINALIZE_MAILS check on the draft-to-finalized transition path.
project_summary: Add mandatory authorization enforcement to the API method execution pipeline. API methods requiring an API key currently authenticate the caller but never check whether the key is granted access to the specific method or whether the key's pseudo-user has the necessary domain rights. This plan closes both gaps by adding an authorize step to the pipeline, extending the API key interface with a required-right declaration, adding HTTP 403 error support, and implementing the required right in all 20 HCP Editor API methods.
